explanation: The game was fashionable at Badminton House, the Duke of Beaufort's estate in Gloucestershire, in the 1870s. It grew from the old children's game battledore and shuttlecock.

claims.text: Badminton is named after Badminton House, the Duke of Beaufort's country house in Gloucestershire, England.
The name badminton does not come from an inventor, an Indian town or a breed of goose.
Badminton became fashionable at Badminton House in the 1870s.
Badminton developed from the children's game battledore and shuttlecock.
